caption:
🚨 Newly leaked footage reveals why Israel was responsible for many/most deaths on October 7, 2023: it ordered the Hannibal Directive.

The Hannibal Directive is a highly controversial military policy historically used by the Israel Defense Forces (IDF). Its core objective is to prevent the capture of Israeli personnel by enemy forces at all costs, even if it requires killing captured Israelis.

Leaked videos from two years ago also show IDF Apache gun ships shooting and killing Israeli citizens at the Nova Music Festival on that day.

And now this ⬆️
implied_frame: Frames the leaked Israel Police command-center recording (aired by Channel 12's 'Uvda' in Feb 2026) as a 'CONFIRMED' smoking gun that Israel ordered the Hannibal Directive on Oct 7, 2023 and was therefore responsible for 'many/most' deaths that day. Verified: the broadcast is real and Commissioner Kobi Shabtai is heard reporting ~five abducted soldiers (N12 primary). Unverified/attributed: the subtitled 'strike Gaza... along with the soldiers who got abducted' line is a social-media translation of an unnamed officer, absent from the Channel 12 source — flagged, not adopted. Group C: the 'most Oct 7 deaths caused by Israel' scale claim has no primary trace. The Hannibal-on-Oct-7 and Nova-helicopter threads are documented in companion y2023 records.
capture_method: Pristine original media + metadata pulled from Instagram's CDN via yt-dlp; delivery webm derived once (VP9 video copied, audio normalized to -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP off the source AAC — no re-recording, no in-place re-encode).
video_download_status: Original pulled via yt-dlp (~2.8 MB); delivery ~2.9 MB webm, 33s.
